name: trellis
description: Build project Playbooks agents can use to reliably repeat work.

interface.longDescription: Trellis helps people turn work they have done before into project-local Playbooks agents can follow again. /trellis-init sets up the collection, /capture-playbook creates the exact Playbook a user describes, /discover-playbooks recommends Playbooks from only the sessions the user selects, and /trellis-audit reviews the collection without changing or executing it. Playbooks remain the only user-facing artifact; supporting tools stay private to a Playbook or project-owned.
defaultPrompt: /capture-playbook Create a release-review Playbook with stop rules and evidence-backed verification.
/discover-playbooks Find reusable methods in this conversation and return capture prompts without writing files.
/trellis-audit Review this project's Playbooks for unclear triggers, overlap, and weak verification without changing files.
